t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Each round, a 1 of the sets of gnomes will appear. For each pair, discover which gnome is higher paying than the other. Use the 1x rounds to test gnomes, and 5x when you are sure.

vb_textbox.text: Each round has a pair of gnomes. Each gnome will always be paired with the same gnome each round. The order in which the gnomes appear will not matter (blue - yellow; yellow-blue). Using the 1x rounds to test each gnome, and use the 5x rounds on the gnome you are more sure has a higher payout. There seems to be some switch, midway through the survey where you should start probing gnomes with the 1x again to determine their new value.
